items.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
items.title_zh: “已做好应对任何风暴的准备”：阿联酋部长对经济持乐观态度，国际货币基金组织上调经济预测
items.summary: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.
items.summary_zh: 阿联酋对明年实现7%至8%的经济增长持乐观态度，并寄希望于一种“与众不同”的经济模式。

items.title: China’s Xiamen Airlines to buy 50 Boeing jets in $7.4 billion deal
items.title_zh: 中国厦门航空公司斥资74亿美元购买50架波音飞机
items.summary: Xiamen Airlines has agreed to purchase 50 Boeing 737-8 aircraft with a combined catalog price of around $7.4 billion.
items.summary_zh: 厦门航空已同意购买50架波音737-8飞机，总目录价格约为74亿美元。

items.title: SoftBank drops 15% as Wall Street AI sell-off ripples across Asian tech names
items.title_zh: 随着华尔街人工智能股抛售潮蔓延至亚洲科技股，软银股价下跌15%
items.summary: Asian technology stocks tumbled Wednesday, led by a rout in Japanese semiconductor stocks, as renewed concerns over the artificial intelligence trade rattled investors.
items.summary_zh: 周三，亚洲科技股大幅下挫，其中日本半导体股领跌，原因是投资者对人工智能贸易的担忧再度升温。

items.title: ‘Glee’ Star Jenna Ushkowitz Says Show’s Cory Monteith Tribute ‘Wasn’t the Right Thing’ to Do: ‘It Was Too Soon… We Were Grieving’
items.title_zh: 《欢乐合唱团》明星珍娜·乌什科维茨表示，该剧对科里·蒙蒂斯的致敬“不是正确做法”：“时间太仓促了……我们还在悲痛中。”
items.summary: Jenna Ushkowitz, who starred as Tina Cohen-Chang for the entirety of “Glee,” is reflecting on how the Fox series addressed the real-life death of her fellow cast member Cory Monteith, and why she now feels it “wasn’t the right thing” to do at the time.
items.summary_zh: Jenna Ushkowitz在《欢乐合唱团》（Glee）全剧中饰演Tina Cohen-Chang，她正在反思这部福克斯剧集是如何处理其同剧演员Cory Monteith在现实生活中的去世的，以及为什么她现在觉得当时的处理方式“并不妥当”。

items.title: Indonesia-France Film Lab Unveils Six Projects as Paris Readies First Southeast Asia Co-Production Forum (EXCLUSIVE)
items.title_zh: 印尼-法国电影实验室揭晓六个项目，巴黎筹备首届东南亚合拍论坛（独家）
items.summary: Six Indonesian projects, each from a director-producer pairing working on a debut or sophomore feature, have been chosen for the 2026 Indonesia-France Film Lab X MTN Lab, which runs Nov. 25-30 in Yogyakarta as part of JAFF Market.
items.summary_zh: 2026年印尼-法国电影实验室X MTN实验室已选出六个印尼项目，每个项目均由导演-制片人搭档负责，他们正在制作首部或第二部长片。该实验室将于11月25日至30日在日惹举办，是JAFF市场的一部分。

items.title: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
items.title_zh: 美国金融犯罪局披露“网络安全事件”
items.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed on Tuesday that it's investigating a "cybersecurity incident." The bureau, which is part of the Treasury Department, said it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its…
items.summary_zh: 金融犯罪执法网（FinCEN）周二披露，该机构正在调查一起“网络安全事件”。该局隶属于美国财政部，表示正在调查一起“导致未经授权访问其……有限子集的事件”。

items.title: One lame duck and two turkeys as Trump plays the hits at Thanksgiving ceremony
items.title_zh: 特朗普在感恩节仪式上播放热门歌曲，一只跛鸭和两只火鸡
items.summary: Levity was in short supply as president, reeling from midterms rout, talked up his achievements – and fixated on White House vanity project For some, it was his pardoning of the January 6 rioters or the deployment of masked ICE agents.
items.summary_zh: 当总统在期中选举惨败后摇摇欲坠，吹嘘自己的成就，并执着于白宫的虚荣项目时，幽默感就显得尤为稀缺。对于一些人来说，这是他对1月6日暴乱者的赦免，或者是部署戴着面具的移民和海关执法局（ICE）特工。

items.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
items.title_zh: 耶鲁大学的索南菲尔德：英伟达是对美国工业实力的“损害”，而不是领军企业
items.summary: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the…
items.summary_zh: 耶鲁大学的杰弗里·索南菲尔德（Jeffrey Sonnenfeld）警告称，周一市场欢呼雀跃的事件——即黄仁勋在白宫的支持下重返英伟达担任首席执行官和董事会成员——可能被证明是一个巨大的错误，使董事们面临日益增多的诉讼所带来的“历史性”个人责任，并增加了……

items.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
items.title_zh: 据报道，特朗普表示赦免黄仁勋“是一个选项”
items.summary: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋正面临着对其与黄梓珊关系的持续质疑。黄梓珊是一位高管，据称与中国情报部门有联系，她曾就职于一家被指控非法将Nvidia芯片转运至中国的公司。

items.title: ‘Not about notches on bedpost’: people in Great Britain having less sex – especially young adults
items.title_zh: “不是为了在床柱上刻下记号”：英国人性生活次数减少——尤其是年轻人
items.summary: Lancet survey shows under-45s have sex twice a month – down from four times in 1990 – and one in three under-25s have never had intercourse Sex among British adults has slumped in recent decades, with under-45s having half as many monthly encounters as in 1990 and one in three…
items.summary_zh: 《柳叶刀》调查显示，45岁以下的人每月性生活次数为两次，低于1990年的四次；25岁以下的人中，有三分之一从未有过性行为。近几十年来，英国成年人的性生活急剧下降，45岁以下的人每月性生活次数是1990年的一半，而……
